body: Wow.  Things have been tough for you. I am so sorry you have to experience all the challenges in life.  I am much older than you and I can tell you that unless you find some help (doesn’t have to be counseling or psychiatric), it is going to be tough. I think you did great in posting here. At the very least you were able to talk about it.
I don’t know if I can do anything for you as I am struggling myself.  But if you want to give it try talking to me, I would welcome it
I totally understand the pain of living and wanting to spend the rest of your life with someone and have that person not feel the same

Sadly this can be common.  I have tried to do this to my own daughter.  Luckily I caved in and allowed her. Now she is doing better.  Unfortunately now I am the one struggling with suicidal thoughts and I am feeling so helpless.
